arabic text: Teri Ummat Ke Zewar Pehan Kar Dekho Nana Chali Hoon Main\nSham.
english translation text: Wearing the ornaments your nation gave\nus, behold, Grandfather—I depart for Shaam.

arabic text:
Main Deti Kafan Tujh Ko Bhaiya Gar Sar Pe Rida Mere Hoti.
Gar Hote Khule Hath Mere Tere Zakhmo Ko Hathon Se Dhoti.
Paband-e-Rasan Sar Barehna Dekho Bhaiya Chali Hoon Main
Sham.
english translation text:
I would have given you a shroud, my brother, had
a veil remained upon my head. Had my hands been
free, I would have washed your wounds with them. Bound
in ropes and bareheaded, behold, brother—I depart for Shaam.

arabic text:
Jis Zainab(SA) Ko Tum Ne Baradar Kabhi Nazrein Utha Kar Na
Dekha.
Hath Rasi Se Mere Bandhe Hain Our Sar Par Nahi Mere Parda.
Kaise Kofe Mein Jaon Gi Ghazi(AS) Jab Balway Mein Aye Ga
Naa.
english translation text:
Brother, you never even raised your gaze
towards this Zainab. My hands are
tied with rope, and no covering remains
upon my head. How will I
enter Kufa, Ghazi, when the crowds gather?

arabic text:
Jaise Darbar Paas Aa Raha Hai Mera Dill Dobta Ja Raha Hai.
Han Main Tu Ghar Mein Bhi Kam Bolti Thi Bhai Tum Ko Tu
Sab Kuch Pata Hai.
Kis Tarha Se Kare Gi Bata De Ik Sharabi Se Zainab(SA) Kalam.
english translation text:
As the court draws nearer, my heart
continues to sink. I spoke little even
at home, brother—you knew this well. Tell me,
how will Zainab speak to a drunkard?

arabic text:
Dill Yeh Kehta Hai Ro Ro Ke Bhaiya Kash Abbas(AS) Mojod
Hota.
Kat Deta Woh Oss Ki Zubaan Ko Koi Baghi Agar Mujh Ko
Kehta.
Dekhti Phir Main Kis Tarha Leta Koi Zainab(SA) Ka Majme
Mein Naam.
english translation text:
My heart says, weeping: if only
Abbas were present. He would cut
out the tongue of anyone who
called me a rebel. Then I
would see how anyone dared speak
Zainab's name before the crowd.

arabic text:
Keh Rahe Hain Yeh Hans Hans Ke Shami Aane Wale Hain
Darbar Baghi.
Jis Ne Ajdad Mare Hamare Aa Rahi Hai Yahan Oss Ki Beti.
Kholta Pani Phainko Chatoon Se Pathron Ka Karo Intezam.
english translation text:
The people of Shaam laugh and say: the rebels
are coming to the court. The daughter of the
one who killed our ancestors is approaching. Pour
boiling water from the rooftops and prepare the stones.

arabic text:
Haye Nana(SAWW) Main Kaise Sunaon Darbar-e-Shaqi Ka
Woh Manzar.
Sab Qari-o-Hafiz The Bethe Our Sar Pe Mere Na Thi Chadar.
Haye Nana(SAWW) Teri Betiyon Ko Kyun Laye Hain Sar
Nangay Aam
english translation text:
Alas, Grandfather, how can I describe
that tyrant's court? All the reciters
and memorizers sat there, while no chadar
covered my head. Grandfather, why were
your daughters brought bareheaded before the public?

arabic text:
Tere Abid(AS) Pe Tari Ghashi Thi Our Kulsoom(SA) Sehmi
Khari Thi.
Kahbi Dekhon Main Zakhmi Sakina(SA) Jis Ke Daman Mein
Aag Lagi Thi.
Kabhi Roaon Main Apni Rida Ko Kabhi Dekhon Main Jalte
Khaiyaam.
english translation text:
Your Abid repeatedly fainted, while Kulsum
stood terrified. At times I
looked at wounded Sakina, whose garment
was burning; at times I
wept for my veil, and at
times for the burning tents.

arabic text:
Tere Bachoon Ko Le Kar Gayi Main Shab Bhar Sari Roti Rahi
Hoon.
Kabhi Ghazi(AS) Ka Lehja Badal Ke Main Pehre Bhi Deti Rahi
Hoon.
Inn Bewah Baho Betiyoon Se Kyun Karte Nahi Ho Kalam.
english translation text:
I took your children and wept
throughout the night. At times I
imitated Ghazi's voice and stood
guard. Why do you not speak
to these widows and daughters?

arabic text:
Jab Roti Thi Bali Sakina(SA) Our Baba Ko Apne Bulati.
Main Deti Thi Oss Ko Tasali Our Seene Pe Apne Sulati.
Rothi Zindaan Mein Masoom Bachi Le Le Ke Woh Baba Ka
Naam.
english translation text:
When little Sakina wept and called her
Baba, I consoled her and put her
to sleep upon my chest. The innocent child
died in prison, repeatedly calling Baba's name.
